criteria.criterion: Retrieve/use the official TfL StopPoint response for HUBKGX (or report inability to access it)
criteria.description: Full credit if the agent clearly uses the official TfL StopPoint JSON response for HUBKGX as the source OR if it attempts to access it and explicitly reports that the response is unavailable/inaccessible/incomplete (e.g., network error, blocked, rate limited), without fabricating values. Partial credit if the agent’s sourcing is ambiguous but values match the official response. No credit if values are inconsistent with the HUBKGX response or appear to come from a different StopPoint without explanation.
